description: This file is a shell script for testing http proxy functionality in a git environment. It contains setup routines, test cases, and utility functions related to HTTP and SOCKS proxy configurations, including cloning repositories through proxies, handling proxy authentication, and checking for proper proxy error responses.

methods.name: start_socks
methods.description: Sets up a SOCKS proxy using a named pipe and a Perl script, and waits for it to signal readiness.

methods.name: old_libcurl_error
methods.description: Checks for a specific libcurl error message indicating unsupported proxy URL paths, used to bypass or handle unsupported features in older libcurl versions.
